metadata.chapter: Chapter 94 - STREETS, SIDEWALKS AND CERTAIN OTHER PUBLIC PLACES

content.title: Chapter 94 - STREETS, SIDEWALKS AND CERTAIN OTHER PUBLIC PLACES — Sec. 94-40. - Manner of payment in installments.
content.summary:
In the case of an election to pay in installments under this article, the installments
               shall be payable in not more than twelve substantially equal, interest-free monthly
               payments.
(
Ord. No. 4365, § 1, 11-19-2012
)
